dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast, sharp boundaries between dark gray and white rectangular blocks along the outer edges of the folded wings.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: An almond-shaped patch of rufous/orange-brown plumage on the central nape area.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse transition from a dark gray crown to a lighter gray mantle, primarily demarcated by the intervention of a rufous nape patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-contrast, circular magenta/pink mark is present on the upper right quadrant of the crown.
other_distinctive_markers: Strongly defined transverse white-and-black banding across the entire visible surface of the tail.
